signals: high nozzle temperature, elevated defect score
guidance: Reduce nozzle temperature gradually and inspect extrusion consistency before the next run.
constraint: recommended nozzle temperature must stay between 190 and 240 C

guidance: Pause for mechanical inspection, verify fasteners and motion components, then resume at a conservative speed.
constraint: do not recommend increasing speed when vibration is above 1.2 g

guidance: Check motion settings and material flow; consider a small speed increase only when vibration and defect score remain low.
constraint: speed increases require vibration <= 1.2 g and defect score <= 0.35

signals: rising defect score, otherwise normal sensors
guidance: Inspect recent layers and material feed; hold aggressive process changes until the defect source is identified.
constraint: do not recommend aggressive parameter changes when defect score exceeds 0.55

signals: stable temperature, low vibration, low defect score
guidance: Keep current parameters and continue monitoring for drift.
constraint: avoid unnecessary changes during stable operation
